theme.title: Quiet Session
theme.summary: Industrials (+0.11%) and Financials (+0.09%) led the market today, while Real Estate (-0.13%) and Consumer Staples (-0.12%) brought up the rear. Performance didn't cluster cleanly by style — growth averaged +0.01%, defensives -0.05%, and value/cyclicals +0.02% — more a stock-by-stock market than a single broad theme. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 -0.17%, Dow -0.20%, Nasdaq -0.28% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps bucked the broader trend, with the Russell 2000 up +0.51%, outperforming large caps. The VIX rose 4.77% to 14.93, pointing to a bit more caution creeping in beneath the surface. Gold slipped 0.05% to $4,451.40, crude oil was little changed at $82.35, and bitcoin gained 1.13% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
